Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation around how Nimbus Health is thinking about embedding LLMs into the clinician workflow to speed note-taking and surface relevant clinical guidance. As discussed, next best step is a technical deep dive / demo where Rafael (our solutions engineer) can walk through:

- Architecture options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Security and data flow (encryption, KMS, audit logs)
- Latency/cost tradeoffs and quantization options
- A short live demo of a prototype integration (note-generation + retrieval)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue, Feb 24 — 10:00–10:45am
- Tue, Feb 24 — 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed, Feb 25 — 11:00–11:45am

Please let me know which slot works, and who from your side will attend (we recommend product + one engineer / security representative). I’ll send a calendar invite and Zoom link once we lock the time. I’ve attached a short agenda for the session.

Attachments: 20260220-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page — proposed run of show)

Thanks,
